claim: Market Liquidity is a scientifically recognized standalone construct
evidence_summary: Liquidity is supported in the literature as distinct from volatility market regime momentum and volume.
scope_boundary: Scientific relevance only; no predictive or economic claim.

claim: LIQ-001 faithfully operationalizes an Amihud-style aggregate daily illiquidity proxy
evidence_summary: Construct was frozen as abs(log return)/dollar volume aggregated by cross-sectional median and implemented deterministically.
scope_boundary: Only this daily OHLCV-based proxy; not full liquidity.

claim: LIQ-001 is internally coherent as a daily aggregate illiquidity measure
evidence_summary: Schema coverage warmup behavior and stress-date plausibility were supported; capped symbol universe limits strength.

claim: LIQ-001 represents aggregate price-impact liquidity stress
evidence_summary: High LIQ-001 periods align with higher volatility larger absolute moves deeper drawdown context and MR-001 STRESS overlap.

claim: LIQ-001 contains predictive information about future realized volatility
evidence_summary: Future realized-volatility information coefficients were positive across preregistered horizons.
scope_boundary: Predictive risk information only; no trading return claim.

claim: LIQ-001 contains predictive information about future absolute market movement
evidence_summary: Future absolute-move information coefficients were positive across preregistered horizons.

claim: LIQ-001 contains predictive information about future drawdown risk
evidence_summary: Drawdown-risk signal was positive but materially weaker than volatility and MR-STRESS occurrence evidence.

claim: LIQ-001 contains predictive information about future MR-001 STRESS occurrence
evidence_summary: MR-STRESS occurrence classification showed strong AUC evidence across horizons.
scope_boundary: Dependent on existing MR-001 construct definition.

claim: LIQ-001 provides economic utility in predefined risk-management workflows
evidence_summary: Economic utility was strongest for regime-aware portfolio risk control and partial for risk budgeting volatility targeting and hedge activation.
scope_boundary: Only evaluated use cases; not universal.

claim: LIQ-001 is a standalone alpha factor
evidence_summary: Alpha generation and directional return superiority were not evaluated and cannot be inferred.

claim: LIQ-001 is an exact execution-cost or order-book liquidity model
evidence_summary: The construct intentionally excludes spreads order-book depth intraday immediacy and resiliency.

claim: LIQ-001 is ready as a completed scientific construct within the V3.0 framework
evidence_summary: The construct completed the full lifecycle through classification and has a coherent evidence profile.
scope_boundary: Completed construct; still limited by data scope and proxy assumptions.
